ORDER (a) In the event of arrest of the applicant-Suraj Harish Thakkar in First Information Report No.0736 of 2022 dated September 19, 2022 registered with Manpada Police Station, the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing P.R. bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one or more sureties in the like amount.
(b) The applicant to report to the Manpada police station, every alternate day, between 4.00 p.m.
and 6.00 p.m. till filing of the chargesheet.
(c) The applicant shall furnish the details of his residential address and phone numbers to the investigating officer.
7. The application is disposed of.
